# job_launcher/log.txt -- every launch made through job_launcher/submit, in the launcher's format:
# one entry per job (date, host, working directory, name, the command, the
# binary's branch@commit, and for blocking builds/regressions the verdict).
# Appended by job_launcher/submit, which copies what the launcher's submit wrote to its own
# log during the call.  Tracked on purpose: it is the experimental record that
# tools/heuresis/ledger/ cites.  Do not edit entries by hand.
